Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

diet — the food you usually eat. Example: A happy diet has got fruit and vegetables.
healthy — good for your body. Example: A healthy diet is important.
fruit — the sweet part of a plant you eat. Example: I eat fresh fruit every day.
vegetable — a plant you eat, like a carrot. Example: There are some vegetables on the plate.
sugar — a sweet white substance. Example: There is some sugar in the cake.
fat — the oily part of food. Example: There isn't much fat in this meal.
meal — the food you eat at one time. Example: I have three meals a day.
water — the clear liquid we drink. Example: Drink a lot of water.
fresh — recent and not old. Example: I buy fresh fruit.
balance — a good mixture of things. Example: Balance is important in a diet.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• There are some vegetables.
• There is some sugar.
• How much ...?
• How many ...?
• A little, not much.
